# Staxel Voxel Female Attribution

This directory contains an unmodified third-party source asset used only for an
isolated Knowhere client preview.

This work is based on "Staxel Voxel Female"
(https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/staxel-voxel-female-debe55a5358b4efc89e346ab4a7d4d57)

Commercial use is allowed under the included license, provided this attribution
is retained. The unmodified source, its `license.txt`, glTF/BIN, and texture are
in `source/`. No derived gameplay asset has been approved.
